clips.title: The story
paras: In the northern Barrens, the Cats Eye Emerald has drawn the eye of Ratchet's Wharfmaster Dizzywig. Venture Company bosses keep the fist-sized gem under guard at Boulder Lode Mine.

Venture Company laborers struck a massive emerald at Boulder Lode Mine, northeast of the Sludge Fen. Word of the find spread quickly across the savanna. In goblin country, rare gemstones seldom stay secret. Trade gossip carried news from Ratchet's docks to Booty Bay, and Wharfmaster Dizzywig heard of the prize. He began plotting to send it to the open market in Undermine.

Venture Company management keeps the emerald inside the mine under heavy guard. Overseers, Enforcers, and chief operators such as Boss Copperplug defend it from rival cartels and fortune-hunters. Dizzywig has promised a fifty-percent cut to those who help him secure the gem.
